description.value: Barb's Fish & Chips is a floating restaurant moored in Victoria's Inner Harbour, serving classic fish and chips from a converted two-storey vessel with a distinctive blue roof. It is a long-standing Victoria landmark and a natural stop for cyclists arriving via the Inner Harbour pathways. The waterfront setting and casual takeout-style format make it a memorable rest point on any touring loop through the city.

The OSM record itself is consistent with the well-known Victoria Inner Harbour floating fish-and-chips establishment.
